answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The ridge edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 40 clones produces a signature the jade analysis flags immediately. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the plume settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
